name: adbc_scanner
description: Connect DuckDB to databases through Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC) drivers. ATTACH a database, then query Arrow results, execute remote SQL, and inspect its catalog by alias. Examples target the attached-database API; older community builds expose the previous connection-handle functions.

cta.title: Talk to Any ADBC-Speaking Database
cta.description: Query, write, and inspect external databases through their ADBC drivers, with Arrow batches at the DuckDB interface.

quickStart.title: Attach a SQLite database
quickStart.sql:
ATTACH ':memory:' AS db (TYPE adbc, driver 'sqlite');
DETACH db;

quickStart.title: Query SQLite with an explicit result schema
Execute remote DDL and DML with CALL
Commit and roll back with DuckDB transactions
